fusions.name: Paying Out
fusions.desc: Casts a trailing line that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Startle Whip
fusions.desc: Whips your trailing line round, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 25%.

fusions.name: Warning Strand
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Felt It Coming
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
